title: Pixel lanterns round 2: more complex (606 D1, D6, D5)
desc: J on 606 D1 Vault, D6 Armillary and D5 Crystal: "make these more complex". Three takes each: layered frames, fins and blades, gold drips, glowing bowls, a sculpted port, and see-through glass with an inner core carrying the G3 flare. Every take fits the jar's ~2,500-box budget.

takes.name: Vault: cathedral
takes.facts: 606 D1 with a two-tier roof, corner finials, angular blades sweeping up from each corner; core inside; 838 boxes

takes.name: Vault: molten
takes.facts: 606 D1 with gold drips running from the roof down the panels, a knuckled handle; core inside; 940 boxes

takes.name: Vault: bastion
takes.facts: wider stepped base, buttress fins, panels split by cross mullions, a glowing bowl crown on struts; core inside; 1,064 boxes

takes.name: Armillary: orrery
takes.facts: four rings (one tilted 30 degrees), studs on the crossings, a finned pedestal; core inside; 1,826 boxes

takes.name: Armillary: cradle
takes.facts: the globe held by four kinked blade arms rising from the pedestal, engraved equator band, knuckled bail; 1,292 boxes

takes.name: Armillary: molten
takes.facts: 606 D6's rings, gold drips from a crown that is a glowing bowl; core inside; 1,907 boxes

takes.name: Crystal: faberge
takes.facts: eight ribs with gem studs at engraved bands, a tiered octagon base; core inside; 1,899 boxes

takes.name: Crystal: winged
takes.facts: angular wing blades sweep from the base up the sides, two low fins frame the port; core inside; 1,486 boxes

takes.name: Crystal: molten
takes.facts: ribs at both ends, gold drips from the top cup, a glowing bowl crown; core inside; 1,862 boxes
